content_data.meeting_title: Spring/Summer Collection 2025 Design Review & Concept Finalization
agenda_items: Feedback session on key capsule collection pieces
Discussion on color palettes and material selections
Review of mood boards and initial sketches for SS25
key_decisions: Established a preliminary sourcing strategy for organic cotton and recycled synthetics.
Confirmed the primary color palette, with minor adjustments to accent shades.
action_items: Draft initial campaign brief based on agreed visual direction - Marketing Lead Maya Singh (due in 10 days)
Refine mood boards to better reflect 'Coastal Serenity' theme - Designer Ava Chen (due in 3 days)
Schedule follow-up meeting for prototype review - Executive Assistant (due in 14 days)
